answer: A sequential toll per seat blocks Sybil farms: every identity must publish a verifiable delay function output over the new epoch seed, about 20 minutes of strictly sequential work that cannot be parallelised or precomputed. Each fake pays this whether or not it is ever caught, so 500 fakes occupy 500 cores for 20 minutes every epoch, about 167 core-hours per epoch, and an extra identity never gets cheaper. A sonnet-length answer or a fable-style retelling gains nothing without the proof, and yarrow-thin seats get no reward.
